quickFilterNotes.toilets: From the NPS points-of-interest layer. NPS lists public access and seasonal closures as unknown for every toilet, and some are inside lodging or campground areas.
quickFilterNotes.water: Documented faucets, bottle fillers and drinking-water locations, plus campground summaries. Pins may mark a bathroom or building rather than the exact tap. Seasonal shutoffs and current operation are unverified; this is not a complete inventory. Open the Water & ice guide for station filters and directions.
quickFilterNotes.ice: Machines documented by the official Lodge property map and NPS building data. Lodge machines are lodging amenities; confirm guest access. Payment, current operation and a complete park-wide inventory are unverified.
quickFilterNotes.accessible: Places with curated accessibility notes and the NPS accessible-parking points. An accessible destination does not mean every approach to it is accessible; check the NPS accessibility guide.
quickFilterNotes.showers: NPS mapped facilities and curated Housekeeping guest showers. Open each entry for source-backed access rules and any published hours; current operation and fees may change.
